title: Describe folder removals in folder.rs apply and origin-audit comments and guard messages
outcome: Describe folder removals in folder.rs apply and origin-audit comments and guard messages
acceptance: The apply_planned_changes contract comment in src/storage/work/task_sync/folder.rs names admitted execution-free removals beside additions and scalar edits

The audit_origins comment and the dangling-reference and origin-audit guard messages in folder.rs say 'folder change' (or equivalent) rather than 'folder addition', so a deletion-only import is not misattributed

completion.summary:
Landed in de18e4ee on origin/master. In folder.rs:
- The apply_planned_changes contract names additions, scalar edits, relation edits and execution-free removals.
- The dangling-reference and origin-audit guard messages say "folder change".
- audit_origins describes additions or removals: admission judges additions against the origin history, and removals leave origins unchanged.
The docs state the retained_reference referrer tie-break by walk order. Full gate test-7421dc84 PASS on freeze 4fad3ca4. The r3 review pair was clean. Pre-commit evaluation 5ea738b0 passed 2/2. Installed build 47ade72d.
